{{Quote|What's the matter? You guys want to live forever? Move it out!|The sergeant|<ref name="Rebel" />}}
A '''sergeant''' fought for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] prefaced a section in the ground combat chapter of his report entitled "[[Report on Growth, Organization, Equipment, Activities, and Objectives of the Rebellion]]" by quoting the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] calling a Rebel group to arms.<ref name="Rebel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Rebel sergeant was mentioned in the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Paul Murphy]] in [[1990]] and [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|revised]] in [[1994]] by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]].<ref name="Rebel" />
